items.title: Hacker Group Claims to Have Stolen Trump Mobile Customers’ Personal Data
items.description: Trump Mobile customers’ personal data has appeared on a dark web leak site after a ransomware group called BYOD claimed it breached the company. The published file reportedly contains 3,615 records, including names, email addresses, phone numbers, home addresses, and order details.
